# 798. Smallest Rotation with Highest Score

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(n))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def bestRotation(self, nums):
        """
        :type nums: List[int]
        :rtype: int
        """
        n = len(nums)
        change = [1] * n
        for i in range(n):
            change[(i - nums[i] + 1) % n] -= 1
        for i in range(1, n):
            change[i] += change[i - 1]
        return change.index(max(change))
```
